itens.titulo: “O investidor trocou Vale por Petrobras”: a combinação que faz a mineradora perder R$ 24 bilhões enquanto o Ibovespa festeja
itens.descricao: “O investidor trocou Vale por Petrobras”: a combinação que faz a mineradora perder R$ 24 bilhões enquanto o Ibovespa festeja Seu Dinheiro
trechos: A mineradora acumula desvalorização de 8% desde a eleição, o que representa uma perda de R$ 24,64 bilhões em valor de mercado.
Em outubro, as ações recuam 5%, reduzindo a capitalização da companhia em R$ 15,13 bilhões.

O movimento pode parecer contraintuitivo, já que um dos grandes responsáveis pelo desempenho do principal índice de ações da B3 é o fluxo gringo, que já descarregou mais de R$ 18,5 bilhões por aqui no mês.
Mas no caminho três fatores pressionaram a Vale: o petróleo, o dólar e outra gigante da bolsa, a Petrobras (PETR4).
Na teleconferência de resultados do segundo trimestre de 2026, Rogério Nogueira, vice-presidente executivo de Desenvolvimento Comercial da Vale, deu um recado ao mercado: olho no petróleo.

Leia Também Quase três meses depois, o petróleo Brent, usado como padrão internacional e referência nesse caso, segue como estava quando Nogueira fez o aviso: acima dos US$ 100 o barril, graças à guerra persistente que se desenrola no Oriente Médio.

O Itaú BBA, por exemplo, projeta que o aumento do frete deve pressionar o Ebitda da divisão de ferrosos, estimado pelo Itaú BBA em US$ 2,66 bilhões no terceiro trimestre, queda de 13% na comparação anual.
Segundo o banco, esse custo mais elevado deve mais do que neutralizar a alta de 4% nos embarques, projetados em 82,7 milhões de toneladas.

itens.titulo: General Motors Sinks 6% Despite Earnings Beat and New Buyback as Outlook Narrows; Ford Slips, Tesla Barely Budges
itens.descricao: General Motors Sinks 6% Despite Earnings Beat and New Buyback as Outlook Narrows; Ford Slips, Tesla Barely Budges Yahoo Finance
trechos: - Ford slipped just 2% on the same news while Tesla barely moved, confirming the 8% selloff is entirely GM-specific.
- GM's international profit cratered 87% and commodity costs are hitting the top of prior ranges, clouding an otherwise strong North American quarter.
General Motors (NYSE:GM) coupled a Q3 2026 earnings beat with a fresh buyback, yet its full-year outlook is drawing sellers.
In morning trading, General Motors shares are down 6% to $77.87.
Meanwhile, Ford Motor (NYSE:F) stock is down 2% to $11.94, a softer slide.
Tesla (NASDAQ:TSLA) shares are down 0.3% to $366.95, holding close to even by comparison.
For a sector-level check, the Consumer Discretionary Select Sector SPDR ETF (NYSEARCA:XLY) is down 0.1% to $114.40.
At the same time, the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (NYSEARCA:SPY) is down 0.2% to $764.77, noting the General Motors stock selloff as company-specific.

itens.descricao: 3M tops forecasts for Q3 profit and full-year guidance; shares climb Yahoo Finance
trechos: Investing.com -- 3M on Tuesday reported better-than-expected third-quarter earnings, and its full-year guidance also came in above consensus estimates.
The company posted earnings per share of $2.50, above the $2.39 analysts expected.
Revenue was $6.6 billion, roughly in line with the $6.61 billion consensus, with organic growth of 3.3%.
Adjusted operating margin was 26.2%, compared with an estimate of 25.2%.

"We delivered another quarter of strong results, including solid sales growth, continued margin expansion, double-digit EPS growth, and robust free cash flow," said William Brown, 3M Chairman and CEO.
It expects adjusted total sales growth of more than 4.5%, including adjusted organic growth of more than 3.5%.
Adjusted operating cash flow is expected to be about $5.9 billion, and adjusted free cash flow about $4.8 billion.
3M shares rose in premarket trading, though the gains came before the company's earnings release.

itens.titulo: 3M Reports Third-Quarter 2026 Results; Raises Full-Year EPS Guidance
itens.descricao: 3M Reports Third-Quarter 2026 Results; Raises Full-Year EPS Guidance PR Newswire
itens.texto:
- Q3 GAAP sales of $6.6 billion, up 1.0%; operating margin of 23.7%, up 150 bps; EPS of $2.63, up 70%, all YoY 
  
  - Adjusted sales of $6.6 billion with organic growth of 3.3% YoY
  - Adjusted operating margin of 26.2% on new basis1, up 110 bps YoY
  - Adjusted EPS of $2.50 on new basis1, up 12% YoY
- Q3 operating cash flow of $0.5 billion with adjusted free cash flow of $1.2 billion
- 2026 adjusted EPS guidance raised to $9.10 to $9.15, incorporating new basis1
SAINT PAUL, Minn., Oct. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- 3M (NYSE: MMM) today reported third-quarter results.
"We delivered another quarter of strong results, including solid sales growth, continued margin expansion, double-digit EPS growth, and robust free cash flow," said William Brown, 3M Chairman and CEO. "Improving productivity through structural transformation and a stronger pipeline of differentiated technologies reinforce our confidence in the full-year outlook and long-term growth and margin potential. I want to thank the 3M team for their focus on customers and disciplined execution, which continues to strengthen our performance and create shareholder value."
Third-quarter highlights:
- Adjusted (non-GAAP) reporting updated to treat amortization of intangible assets as a special item for all periods presented; no material year-on-year impact on new basis.
- GAAP EPS of $2.63 and operating margin of 23.7%.
- Adjusted EPS of $2.50, up 12% year-on-year.
- Adjusted operating income margin of 26.2%, up 110 basis points year-on-year.
- Sales of $6.6 billion, up 1.0% year-on-year with organic sales up 0.2% year-on-year.
- Adjusted sales of $6.6 billion, up 4.2% year-on-year with adjusted organic sales up 3.3% year-on-year.
- 3M returned $0.6 billion to shareholders via dividends and share repurchases.
- Cash from operations of $0.5 billion.
- Adjusted free cash flow of $1.2 billion.
1New basis: Updated non-GAAP reporting treats intangible asset amortization as a special item for all periods presented. The change increases base Q3 adjusted operating income margin by approximately 40 bps and adjusted EPS by approximately $0.04. Year-on-year comparisons are not materially impacted as all periods are reflected on the same basis.
Strategic and operational highlights
The following are recently announced highlights:
- 3M entered into an expanded strategic commercial relationship with Amazon to deploy and scale 3M's optical connectivity and other Data Center related products. 3M issued a warrant to Amazon to purchase up to 3.2 million shares of 3M common stock based upon the achievement of $6 billion in cumulative sales of optical connectivity and other Data Center related products over the next seven years, and other event-based milestones.
- 3M is collaborating with Genius Electronic Optical Co., Ltd. (GSEO), an optical technology company, to advance technology development and manufacturing for 3M's Expanded Beam Optics (EBO) solutions. In support of these efforts, 3M is investing to acquire ~4.7% of GSEO's common shares. The collaboration brings together 3M's EBO technology leadership, optical interconnect expertise, materials science, manufacturing scale and customer relationships with GSEO's precision optics manufacturing capabilities and production scale.
- 3M introduced Cooling Film technology for fleet and rail applications, expanding its portfolio of thermal management solutions for transportation customers. Applied to vehicle roofs, the highly reflective performance film uses thermal management technology to reduce heat buildup and help keep interiors noticeably cooler.
- 3M showcased how its materials science expertise supports innovation in golf equipment through its collaboration with PING. By pairing PING's expertise in club design and custom manufacturing with 3M's broad portfolio of materials science solutions, the two companies can collaborate on engineering solutions that turn complex technical challenges into repeatable, high-quality results on the course.
- 3M and BOE established a joint innovation laboratory to accelerate next-generation display technology development. The joint research and development platform brings together BOE's display innovation and end-use application expertise with 3M's materials science capabilities to accelerate higher-performance solutions across LCD, OLED and MLED applications, including improvements in light efficiency, foldable displays and ultra-narrow bezel processes.
- 3M continued to expand its work with U.S. and international government customers, with third-quarter awards supporting defense, health care, and emergency response needs. Awards included PELTOR™ communication and hearing protection solutions for various U.S. military services and Scott SCBAs for the U.S. Navy, respirator and SCBA products for the National Institutes of Health, and respirators for international customers, reflecting 3M's growing work with government partners around the world.
Updated full-year 2026 guidance
3M provided an update to the full-year 2026 guidance provided on July 21, 2026, incorporating the company's performance year-to-date, the acquisition of Madison Fire & Rescue, and a change in non-GAAP treatment of amortization.
- Adjusted total sales growth2 of >4.5 percent, reflecting adjusted organic sales growth2 of >3.5 percent.
- Adjusted EPS2 of $9.10 to $9.15.
- Adjusted operating cash flow2 of ~$5.9 billion with adjusted free cash flow of ~$4.8 billion.
2As further discussed at 5 within the "Supplemental Financial Information Non-GAAP Measures" sections, 3M cannot, without unreasonable effort, forecast certain items required to develop meaningful comparable GAAP financial measures and, therefore, does not provide them on a forward-looking basis reflecting these items.
Conference call
3M will conduct an investor teleconference at 9 a.m. ET (8 a.m. CT) today. Investors can access this conference via the following:
- Live webcast at https://investors.3M.com
- Webcast replay at https://investors.3m

itens.titulo: Ibovespa sobe e dólar cai com mercado atento a pesquisas eleitorais e balanços corporativos
itens.descricao: Ibovespa sobe e dólar cai com mercado atento a pesquisas eleitorais e balanços corporativos Exame
trechos: Mercados: dólar cai enquanto petróleo supera US$ 110 O Ibovespa opera em alta nesta terça-feira, 20, apoiado por bancos, varejistas, construtoras e Petrobras, enquanto o dólar recua 0,67%, cotado a R$ 5,015, frente ao real.
Por volta das 11h (horário de Brasília), o principal índice da B3 avançava 1,37%, aos 207.898 pontos.
Na B3, Petrobras acompanha a força recente do petróleo e PETR3 sobe 1,47%, já PETR4 avança 1,28%.
Vale (VALE3), por outro lado, recua 0,89%.
Entre os bancos, BTG Pactual (BPAC11, do mesmo grupo controlador da EXAME) sobe 2,94%, Bradesco (BBDC4) avança 2,39% e Itaú (ITUB4) ganha 1,73%.
Magazine Luiza (MGLU3) dispara 7,86%, Vamos (VAMO3) sobe 5,55%, Lojas Renner (LREN3) avança 4,67%, C&A (CEAB3) ganha 4,37% e MRV (MRVE3) sobe 4,24%.
Na ponta negativa, além de Vale, Bradespar (BRAP4) cai 1,09%, Embraer (EMBJ3) recua 0,71%, Marfrig/BRF (MBRF3) perde 0,60% e Suzano (SUZB3) cede 0,40%.

"Como parte da valorização após o 1º turno antecipava uma melhora fiscal, a disputa apertada aumenta a exigência por propostas financiáveis e apoio político para executá-las." Juros, inflação e crescimento também seguem no centro das decisões dos investidores.

itens.titulo: Bank of America (BAC): Is Its Deposit Franchise Getting Stronger as Lending Accelerates?
itens.descricao: Bank of America (BAC): Is Its Deposit Franchise Getting Stronger as Lending Accelerates? Yahoo Finance
trechos: Second-quarter average loans increased 8% year over year while deposits rose 2%.
Consumer balances grew approximately 1%, against 8% in Global Banking.
Nevertheless, net interest income increased 9%, showing that uneven deposit growth can coexist with improving lending economics.
Bank of America Corporation (NYSE:BAC) trades at approximately 11x forward P/E versus 13x trailing P/E.
The forward valuation sits above Wells Fargo & Company (NYSE:WFC) at 10x and below JPMorgan Chase & Co. (NYSE:JPM) at 14x.
The rate paid on those deposits fell to 0.48%, from 0.58% a year earlier.
Bank of America Corporation (NYSE:BAC) estimates that 92% of consumer checking accounts are customers' primary accounts.
Loan growth and market activity also contributed to net interest income of $16 billion.

itens.descricao: SpaceX And Tesla Prepare Side By Side Earnings Reports Amid Merger Speculation Yahoo Finance
trechos: Key Stats for SpaceX Stock - Price change for SpaceX stock in last 1 month: -3% - $SPCX Stock Price as of Oct.
19: $148 - 52-Week High: $226 - $SPCX Stock Price Target: $223 What Happened?
SpaceX (SPCX:NASDAQ) reports Q3 results on Tuesday after markets close, and Tesla follows on Wednesday.
Barclays said last week that a deal could come before Tesla's annual meeting on December 3 and sees SpaceX as the more likely buyer.
In an all-stock deal, Barclays estimates Musk would hold about 37% of the equity and 56% of the votes.
For SpaceX, analysts expect revenue of about $12.74 billion, which compares with $7.8 billion in Q2.
In Q2, AI capital spending was $15.8 billion, and Evercore ISI expects SpaceX to exit 2026 at an annualized revenue run-rate of about $104 billion.
It sees capital spending of about $151 billion in 2027.
